select id, merchant_id, category_id, name, description, image_url, base_price, source_template_id, featured_at, status from dishes where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and id = #{dishId} for update
select count(*) from dishes where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status = 'active' and featured_at is not null
mapper.update: update dishes set featured_at = null where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and id = #{dishId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from dish_categories where id = #{categoryId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId}
mapper.insert: insert into dishes (merchant_id, category_id, name, description, image_url, base_price, source_template_id, featured_at, status) values (#{merchantId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{basePrice}, #{sourceTemplateId}, #{featuredAt}, #{status})
mapper.update: update dishes set category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, base_price = #{basePrice}, status = #{status}, featured_at = case when lower(#{status}) = 'inactive' then null else featured_at end where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and id = #{id}
update dishes set status = #{status} where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and id = #{dishId}
update dishes set status = 'inactive', featured_at = null where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and id = #{dishId}
mapper.insert: insert into dish_ingredients (dish_id, ingredient_name, quantity, unit, calc_type) values (#{dishId}, #{ingredientName}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{calcType})
mapper.select: select id, dish_id, ingredient_name, quantity, unit, calc_type from dish_ingredients where dish_id = #{dishId} order by id asc

select mi.id, mi.merchant_id, mi.name, mi.category, mi.unit, count(distinct di.dish_id) as referenced_dish_count, group_concat(distinct d.name order by d.name separator ',') as referenced_dish_names from merchant_ingredients mi left join dish_ingredients di on di.ingredient_name = mi.name left join dishes d on d.id = di.dish_id and d.merchant_id = mi.merchant_id where mi.merchant_id = #{merchantId} group by mi.id, mi.merchant_id, mi.name, mi.category, mi.unit order by mi.category asc, mi.name asc

mapper.delete: delete from merchant_ingredients where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and id = #{ingredientId}
